tldr: Inter Milan cut its posting volume by about a third over the past year and its impressions rose 43 percent, video views 33 percent and followers 20 percent, on club-reported figures.  Rank your last three months of posts by views, cut next month's target by the share sitting below your own median, and spend the freed time on one thing built for people who do not follow you.

Of the YouTube citations OtterlyAI counted in AI answers, 94 percent went to long-form and 5.7 percent to Shorts, with ten-to-twenty-minute videos taking 32.1 percent, because chapter markers let a machine cite a section rather than a whole video.  Add chaptering to your creator contracts as a named deliverable, with each chapter titled for what it actually covers.

Marketers at a Digiday summit described oversight of AI-generated work as 10 percent prompting, 80 percent generated and 10 percent human refinement, and agencies have been staffing that final 10 percent with junior people.  Write a named senior reviewer, by name and grade, into your next production contract.

Marvel's Wolverine opened at 2.8 million hours watched, almost identical to the original Spider-Man, then fell 79 percent by day three where Spider-Man fell 37.  Price your next launch sponsorship on the first 72 hours and make the back half conditional on a day-three watch-time floor.

VALORANT Champions peaked at more than 605,800 concurrent viewers on its opening day, about 108 times the capacity of the Shanghai venue — but on 280 channels against last year's 230, with Chinese platforms excluded, and the clean like-for-like growth is 11.8 percent in English-language viewers.  Demand the channel count, the official-feed share and the excluded platforms in writing before you price an esports peak.

Sephora launched on TikTok Shop with a twelve-piece set it will not sell on its own website, hosted by the creator who co-founded the brand, and had sold about 2,300 units as of publication.  Put one range-exclusive item behind a single social storefront and have its actual owner host the launch stream rather than booking a creator to read about it.

Best Buy is selling connected television against its own purchase data and adding its Blue Shirt store staff to its creator roster, opening on TikTok Shop in late October with roughly 10,000 products.  Get your largest retail partner's creator and television package in writing this month and check it against your own creator spend before the fourth quarter locks.

**INTER MILAN CUT ITS POSTING BY A THIRD AND ITS VIDEO VIEWS WENT UP 33 PERCENT**
Marketing Brew published the numbers on Wednesday.  Impressions up 43 percent, followers up 20 percent, video views up 33 percent, and about a third fewer posts going out to get all of it.  Nobody added budget.  They removed the quota.

**1.** Inter Milan cut its posting volume by about a third over the past year and its impressions rose 43 percent, video views 33 percent and followers 20 percent, on club-reported figures. Add chaptering to your creator contracts as a named deliverable, with each chapter titled for what it actually covers.

Write a named senior reviewer, by name and grade, into your next production contract.
